Threaded Passage.name: Threaded Passage
Threaded Passage.description: The user controls the beam in a succession of short, exact cuts while turning their body, opening locks, restraints and debris around several visible people inside one building. Each cut follows a straight line from the navel, and each person is freed without a direct hit. The user must see every intended surface; one obscured cut is skipped. When the work ends, cramps prevent another laser use until the end of the scene. Strain: severe.
